issues.description: Solution repository Person entity has an inconsistent first-name field: it declares `private String forename;` mapped to column `first_name`, but the class methods still reference a non-existent `firstName` field (e.g., `getFirstName()` returns `firstName`, `setFirstName(...)` assigns to `firstName`, and equals/hashCode use `firstName`). This makes the solution code not compile and also conflicts with template/tests which use the `firstName` attribute consistently.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution consistent by renaming `forename` to `firstName` (keeping `@Column(name = "first_name")`) and ensuring getters/setters/equals/hashCode reference `firstName`; alternatively, if `forename` is intended, update the field references, getters/setters names, and equals/hashCode to use `forename` consistently (and adjust any tests/JSON expectations accordingly).
